headline: Microsoft chief executive Satya Nadella argued that AI agents will not make business software obsolete and that Microsoft wants Copilot to become the operating system for work.
score_reason: Kept at the pool score: a major CEO's view on the AI-versus-software debate, but largely a company pitch.
importance_line: Business customers and software makers are affected, but this is Microsoft's own claim about its products, and GitHub's activity figures are not independently checked.
summary: The Times of India reports that Nadella wrote in an X post that AI lets software be organised around people's work instead of people working around software, and pointed to rising coding activity on GitHub, the code-sharing site, as a sign that more AI agents make trusted record-keeping systems more important. He tied this to Microsoft's own announcements of more than 30 new Copilot skills for its Dynamics 365 business apps and a service that hosts code inside a company's own environment.
notes: Times of India summarises a Nadella X post; the post itself was not opened.
